messages:
marta: quick brain-dump: propose a temporary cross-region delegation mode for resident writes when a tenant's primary is overloaded. not a failover 4a8, more like a short-lived sanctuary write.

sam: high level ok. how transparent to apps?

marta: transparent by default. runtime attaches headers `X-Delegated-Region`, `X-Delegation-Id`, and `X-Delegation-TTL`. clients may opt-in with `X-Allow-Delegation: true`.

kevin: compliance: only allow if tenant has consent token or tenant policy. token = signed JWT with allowed_regions[], expires_at, token_id. runtime validates signature/KID.

lia: ops: prefer lease-style TTL (30s default) and route reads for touched keys to the sanctuary during TTL. emit metrics: delegation_ratio, delegation_latency_p95.

arjun: implement control-plane RPC `RequestDelegation(tenant,reason)` synchronous. return allowed, region, token_id, lease_id. fail-closed if control-plane unreachable (configurable per-tenant).

kevin: idempotency: runtime should stamp a delegation_id per write and reconciliation dedupes by that id. also include `X-Delegation-Audit-Id` for analytics.

sam: minimal MVP: (1) runtime state machine IDLE->DELEGATING->DELEGATED->FAILBACK, (2) headers + telemetry, (3) control-plane consent path. expand later to routing DSL.

lia: testing: chaos on control-plane down, token revoke mid-lease, and read-after-write consistency during TTL. run canary on dedicated.

infra-bot: created ticket INFRA-2622: "temp delegation MVP" and added to sprint. :white_check_mark:

marta: action items: sam draft RPC proto, kevin draft JWT claims and rotation, lia write runbook. reconvene after RFC draft.
